topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I stare at the arrangement on the table, a jumbled mass of petals and thorns that seem to mock me with their silent beauty. No note, no cryptic message, no clue to unravel the mystery of who thought this gesture was even remotely acceptable. It's as if they took a handful of my time and twisted it into something pretty, thinking that would mend fences. I’ll show them. I’ll take this so-called gift and turn it into fertilizer for my own garden, where the only things that grow are the ones I’ve tended to myself. How dare they? These flowers will wither, and so will any thought of forgiveness.
